result.title: Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning
result.summary: LLM agents serve natural-language requests through tools, data sources, and other agents, and even simple requests often need several interdependent calls. Typically, the LLM picks these calls by trial and error, with no guarantee of an executable plan. We present Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning (CGAP), which instead reasons about what a request requires and what tools provide. CGAP compiles the tool catalog deterministically into a PDDL model, uses an LLM to turn the request into goals, and solves the model with a classical planner. Since tool outputs are unknown in advance, the model is abstract, tracking which inputs are available, not their values. During execution, an LLM adds entity-specific calls that abstract plans omit, and deterministic checks reject any that break the plan. Every argument is drawn from a cited source, such as a conversation span or an earlier tool response, and each requested result counts as delivered only after an LLM verifier checks it against the request. With three LLMs on ToolSandbox, ComplexFuncBench, BFCL multi-turn, and $τ^2$-bench retail, CGAP outperforms a standard tool-calling agent by up to 28.9 points.

AI.brief_summary: 将工具目录确定性编译为抽象 PDDL 模型，由 LLM 把请求转成目标、经典规划器求解，执行期再由 LLM 补充实体级调用，并用确定性检查与 LLM 验证器判定结果是否交付，在多个工具调用基准上优于标准工具调用 agent。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「只跟踪输入是否可用、不跟踪取值」的抽象状态，以及执行期校验与结果交付判定，可能为 LVR 的潜状态更新、证据可用性跟踪与停止决策提供可核查线索，但论文本身不涉及视觉或多模态推理。
